column2: [intro]
We dress up, put on our best clothes,
Because tonight, it's the VIP party,
But as soon as we arrive, we step on a duck,
Because the dress code was casual, haha!
It's a matter of context, oh la la!
The key is where you settle, that's it!
In a living room, we act classy,
But in the kitchen, everyone is kissing!
We get ready for a night out at the club,
But there, everyone is dancing in boots,
We don't know where to look,
We should have stayed at the party!
It's a matter of context, oh la la!
The key is where you settle, that's it!
In an office, we take ourselves seriously,
But in a park, we do somersaults together!
[ solo ]
It's true, it's funny how everything changes with the context,
So think carefully before making choices about it!
That's life, we learn to move with the settings,
That's it, my friend, the magic of context, again and again!
[outro]
